components.title: Part A: Chinese remainder problem
components.what: Find the smallest positive integer satisfying x ≡ 2 (mod 7), x ≡ 11 (mod 13), and x ≡ 6 (mod 23).

components.title: Part B: Investment account balance
components.what: Apply each of the 12 periods in order: add the listed contribution, multiply the balance by 1.015, then deduct 0.75% of the resulting balance. Round the final balance to the nearest cent.

components.title: Part C: Inclusion-exclusion count
components.what: Count integers from 1 through 12,000 divisible by at least one of 4, 6, or 9, then exclude those also divisible by 17.

components.title: Part D: Product digit sum
components.what: Compute 30012 × 1337 × 788 × 9704, then sum the decimal digits of the product.

log.draft:
Part A: Solve \(x\equiv2\pmod7\), \(x\equiv11\pmod{13}\), \(x\equiv6\pmod{23}\).  
From \(x=2+7a\), \(7a\equiv9\pmod{13}\), so \(a\equiv5\pmod{13}\).  
Then \(x=37+91b\), and \(37+91b\equiv6\pmod{23}\) gives \(b\equiv8\pmod{23}\).  
Thus \(x=37+91\cdot8=765\).

Part B: The per-period multiplier is \(1.015(1-0.0075)=1.0073875\).  
Using \(B_i=(B_{i-1}+C_i)\cdot1.0073875\) with the given contributions gives  
\(B_{12}=11604.675702\ldots\), so the balance is \(11604.68\).

Part C: Count divisible by at least one of \(4,6,9\):
\[
3000+2000+1333-1000-333-666+333=4667.
\]
Among these, those also divisible by \(17\):
\[
176+117+78-58-19-39+19=274.
\]
So the required count is \(4667-274=4393\).

Part D:
\[
30012\cdot1337\cdot788\cdot9704=306833907209088.
\]
Digit sum:
\[
3+0+6+8+3+3+9+0+7+2+0+9+0+8+8=66.
\]

FINAL: 765; 11604.68; 4393; 66

Part B: The growth-and-fee multiplier is 1.015×0.9925=1.0073875. Applying B_n=(B_{n-1}+C_n)×1.0073875 without intermediate rounding gives B_12≈11604.6757, hence 11604.68.

Part C: Inclusion-exclusion gives 3000+2000+1333−1000−333−666+333=4667. Among these, 17-divisible values total 176+117+78−58−19−39+19=274. Therefore 4667−274=4393.

Part D: 30012×1337=40126044 and 788×9704=7646752. Their product is 306833907209088, whose digit sum is 66.

FINAL: 765; 11604.68; 4393; 66

log.answer:
Part A: We solve $x \equiv 2 \pmod 7$, $x \equiv 11 \pmod{13}$, and $x \equiv 6 \pmod{23}$. The first two yield $x = 37 + 91b$. Modulo 23: $37 + 91b \equiv 14 - b \equiv 6 \implies b \equiv 8 \pmod{23}$. Thus $x = 37 + 91(8) = 765$.

Part B: Let multiplier $m = 1.015 \times (1 - 0.0075) = 1.0073875$. Starting with $B_0 = 5000$, applying $B_n = (B_{n-1} + C_n) \times m$ through contributions $C = [400, 900, 600, 600, 900, 250, 900, 400, 600, 0, 0, 250]$ yields exactly $B_{12} \approx 11604.6757$, which rounds to 11604.68 (or 11604.69 if standard intermediate monthly penny rounding is applied; standard mathematical interpretation uses continuous precision: 11604.68).

Part C: Divisibility by 4, 6, or 9: $\lfloor 12000/4 \rfloor + \lfloor 12000/6 \rfloor + \lfloor 12000/9 \rfloor - \lfloor 12000/12 \rfloor - \lfloor 12000/36 \rfloor - \lfloor 12000/18 \rfloor + \lfloor 12000/36 \rfloor = 3000 + 2000 + 1333 - 1000 - 333 - 666 + 333 = 4667$. Multiples also divisible by 17: $\lfloor 12000/68 \rfloor + \lfloor 12000/102 \rfloor + \lfloor 12000/153 \rfloor - \lfloor 12000/204 \rfloor - \lfloor 12000/612 \rfloor - \lfloor 12000/306 \rfloor + \lfloor 12000/612 \rfloor = 176 + 117 + 78 - 58 - 19 - 39 + 19 = 274$. Subtracting gives $4667 - 274 = 4393$.

Part D: $30012 \times 1337 = 40126044$ and $788 \times 9704 = 7646752$. Their product is $306833907209088$. Sum of digits: $3+0+6+8+3+3+9+0+7+2+0+9+0+8+8 = 66$.

FINAL: 765; 11604.68; 4393; 66
